race.title: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
race.verdict: BOOK OF LIFE and Kelpie Grey are both well treated if things fall right, the former narrowly shading the vote. Barleybrown , Archangel Josepi and Oxford Circus also need a close look in a competitive handicap. BOOK OF LIFE KELPIE GREY BARLEYBROWN
